steps.title: How this test works
steps.body: The TCF Canada speaking test has three tasks: a short talk about yourself, a role-play and an opinion. Here you practise useful sentences out loud and choosing the right reply. At B1 you give an opinion and a reason, and you ask for explanations politely.

steps.fr: À mon avis, il est important d'apprendre le français pour travailler au Canada.
steps.en: In my opinion, it is important to learn French to work in Canada.
steps.tip: À mon avis introduces an opinion. Then give a reason.

steps.fr: D'un côté, c'est pratique, mais de l'autre, c'est cher.
steps.en: On one hand it is practical, but on the other it is expensive.
steps.tip: Use d'un côté, de l'autre to show two sides.

steps.en: Could you explain to me how it works?
steps.tip: A polite way to ask for information in the role-play.

steps.explain: À mon avis means in my opinion.

steps.prompt: You want to refuse politely. Which is best?
options: Ça ne m'intéresse pas du tout.
Je suis désolé, mais je ne suis pas disponible.
steps.explain: Désolé, mais plus a reason keeps it polite.
